verdict.rationale: Unleash documents its own background automation for feature rollouts. Release templates progress through milestones automatically while monitoring application health. Safeguards pause rollouts or disable environments when metrics like error rates or latency cross thresholds, and change requests and date constraints let releases apply at a scheduled time. Missing for 10: no general-purpose trigger/action automation beyond rollouts, no hands-on or independent corroboration that automated progression and safeguards work reliably, and thin detail on configuring and monitoring these automations.
